related.description: Jitsi Meet - Secure, Simple and Scalable Video Conferences that you use as a standalone app or embed in your web application.
🏆 WebRTC - SFU - Simple, Secure, Scalable Real-Time Video Conferences Up to 8k, compatible with all browsers and platforms.
🚀 WebRTC - P2P - Simple, Secure, Fast Real-Time Video Conferences Up to 8k and 60fps, compatible with all browsers and platforms.
The open-source, self-hosted video conferencing software. Scalable, customizable, and with a powerful AI Meeting Agent.
